title: Affine coefficient intersection ring pushout
statement: Let f:X -> T be a separated morphism of schemes, U an affine open of T, Z an affine open of Y=f inverse image U, and g:Tprime -> U, gprime:Xprime -> X, fprime:Xprime -> Tprime a cartesian square over f and g followed by U. Let W=gprime inverse image of the image of Z in X, and let B be an affine open of Tprime. Set I=W intersect fprime inverse image B, A=Gamma(U,O), D=Gamma(Y,Z,O), R=Gamma(Tprime,B,O), and S=Gamma(Xprime,I,O). Use the explicit maps A -> D and D -> S of [def-pc-coefficient-intersection-ring-data], A -> R induced by g and R -> S induced by fprime. Give S its A-algebra via A -> R -> S. The A-D-S and A-R-S scalar towers hold, and S is the pushout of the commutative A-algebras R and D, in the sense that the natural R-algebra homomorphism R tensor_A D -> S is bijective.

proof.text: Use the restricted lift k and its projection equation to prove k inverse image Z = W. The original square restricted to U is cartesian. Apply Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen and isIso_pushoutSection_iff to this square on top, Z, B and I. Simplify coefficientBaseRingMap using appTop, appLE and GammaSpecIso cancellation. Commutativity of the resulting pushout gives IsScalarTower A D S; IsScalarTower A R S is definitional. Convert the categorical ring pushout to Algebra.IsPushout with CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout. This is a complete Lean proof with no new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientIntersection_ring_pushout
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsSeparated f]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z))
    (B : T'.Opens) (hB : IsAffineOpen B) :
    let A := Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)
    let R := Γ(T', B)
    let D := Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, Z)
    let S := Γ(X', W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B)
    let : Algebra A R := (g.appLE ⊤ B (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra A D := (coefficientBaseRingMap f U Z).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra D S := (coefficientIntersectionRingMap f U Z g g' f' sq W hW B).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra R S := (f'.appLE B (W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B) inf_le_right).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra A S := ((f'.appLE B (W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B) inf_le_right).hom.comp
      (g.appLE ⊤ B (by simp)).hom).toAlgebra
    ∃ hD : IsScalarTower A D S, letI := hD
      ∃ hR : IsScalarTower A R S, letI := hR
        Algebra.IsPushout A R D S
